existing_w04_evidence_interpretation.default_noneditable_feature: Selection_is_not_editable is evidence of a noneditable default node, not proof that Selection.isInheriting() is true.
existing_w04_evidence_interpretation.custom_flux_feature: Inheriting_not_allowed is evidence that this test feature rejects the requested inherit operation, not evidence of a supported native inherited feature.

conclusion.decision: Keep T007 native inherited coverage UNVERIFIED. Do not count cfeq1 or w04_test_flux as positive inherited-feature evidence.

documented_semantic_difference.comsol_selection_api: Selection.inherit(boolean) and Selection.isInheriting() describe propagation/inheritance to lower geometric dimension levels.
documented_semantic_difference.project_contract_language: T007 and the current guard wording use inherited-selection and parent-physics-interface language, which describes a parent/child feature relationship but does not define the Java API predicate.
documented_semantic_difference.implication: The predicate itself is lower-dimension semantics. Treating it as proof that a child must be edited through its parent physics interface is not established by the API documentation.
documented_semantic_difference.severity_boundary: This is a semantic/contract risk, not a proven production defect. The direct-edit guard may still be the intended product policy for a documented native feature, but that policy needs real native-feature evidence or an explicit contract clarification.

code_and_contract_pointers.finding: Feature discovery records selection_inheriting from sel.isInheriting() and deliberately leaves selection_editable tri-state; this is the correct evidence boundary for discovery.

Before a child edit, the guard rejects any child whose sel.isInheriting() is true and tells the caller to set the parent physics interface. The API docs establish lower-dimension propagation, not that parent-edit instruction.
selection_kind=inherited calls sel.inherit(True), then reads back inheriting. That operation is the lower-dimension Selection API operation documented by COMSOL.

The public feature-list response correctly calls selection_inheriting an observation and selection_editable tri-state, but does not distinguish lower-dimension propagation from parent-interface inheritance.
The public selection docstring says some features have inherited selections and offers kind=inherited without defining the lower-dimension meaning or a native parent-inherited feature contract.

T007 requires physics-level, feature-level and inherited selection operations, accurate rejection of non-writable inheritance, and selection readback; it does not identify a concrete native feature or the Java meaning of inherit.
Machine-readable T007 repeats the same unspecified inherited-selection requirement and remains NOT_RUN at the contract level.
The phase test plan asks for a noneditable inherited selection but does not bind that phrase to a documented native COMSOL feature.
The contract notes warn that schema validation does not establish COMSOL acceptance or physical semantics; this supports keeping the native inherited case evidence-limited.
The unit test verifies the local branch with a mock Selection.isInheriting() flag. It does not establish native COMSOL feature semantics.
The bounded harness tests parent/child explicit operations, default noneditable rejection and unsupported inherit rejection, while explicitly keeping inherited_guard_on_native_feature UNVERIFIED.
The accepted c12 bounded record is PASS only for default_noneditable_guard, unsupported_inherit_guard and local_input_guard; native inherited feature coverage is UNVERIFIED/NOT_RUN.

source_documents.title: Selection API
source_documents.finding: inherit(boolean) sets the inherit flag; isInheriting() returns true when selection is inherited to lower dimension levels.

source_documents.title: COMSOL Programming Reference Manual
source_documents.finding: The selection inheritance description says include lower-dimensional geometric entities adjacent to already selected entities; isInheriting() is lower-dimension inheritance.

source_documents.title: Selections (general API)
source_documents.finding: Repeats the generic lower-dimension inheritance semantics; no parent physics-interface meaning is defined here.

source_documents.title: PhysicsFeature API
source_documents.finding: Exposes PhysicsFeature.selection() and feature metadata, but does not identify a concrete Layered Shell inherited-selection creation recipe.

source_documents.title: PhysicsFeatureList API
source_documents.finding: Feature lists/tags and create are available; the exact shipped native feature type for this probe was not confirmed.

source_documents.title: Physics API
source_documents.finding: Physics feature creation/list APIs are documented generically, without a verified native inherited-selection recipe.

source_documents.title: ModelEntityList API
source_documents.finding: Generic tags/get/remove access exists for model entities; it does not establish a native feature type or inheritance semantics.

source_documents.title: Physics Interface Default Nodes
source_documents.finding: Default node selections cannot be changed; this is a noneditable-default rule and is not stated as Selection.inherit.

source_documents.title: Physics Builder Manual
source_documents.finding: Physics Builder documents propagate-to-lower-dimensions selection behavior. This supports the generic API meaning but is not a shipped feature acceptance result.

source_documents.title: The Layered Shell Interface
source_documents.finding: Layered Shell is a documented physics interface candidate under Structural Mechanics; its default nodes are described in the layered-shell documentation.

source_documents.title: Shell Properties and Interface Selection Sections
source_documents.finding: Layer physics nodes commonly inherit their default selection from the physics interface or parent node. This is the strongest documented parent-inherited candidate, but it does not prove Selection.isInheriting() or inherit(True) behavior for a live model.

source_documents.title: Linear Elastic Material (Layered Shell)
source_documents.finding: The default material node selection is always inherited from the interface and cannot be changed; this is documented UI/model semantics, not a native engine run here.

source_documents.title: Initial Values (Layered Shell)
source_documents.finding: The default Initial Values node uses the same parent/interface selection inheritance wording.

source_documents.title: The Composite Materials Module
source_documents.finding: Composite Materials Module is the optional add-on associated with Layered Shell; runtime license support was not tested in this research.

source_documents.title: Dome Tweeter with Composite Diaphragm
source_documents.finding: A documented Application Library case uses Layered Shell/Composite Materials. The model binary and a Java creation recipe were not established here.

candidate_native_feature.candidate: Layered Shell default material or Initial Values node
candidate_native_feature.why_candidate: The 6.4 layered-shell documentation explicitly describes default node selections inherited from the physics interface or parent node.
candidate_native_feature.required_next_evidence: A fresh authorized model/fixture with the documented candidate, actual selection readback, and an attempted edit/guard outcome. No such run was performed.

license_scope.documented_prerequisite: Layered Shell is documented with the Composite Materials Module.

api_gui_boundary.finding: The inspected generic Java APIs expose model loading, physics features, selection access and feature lists, but no exact shipped Java creation type/recipe for a Layered Shell parent-inherited node was identified. Do not claim that a GUI is required; do not claim that an API-only creation recipe is established.

recommended_root_decision.guard_review: Review whether the product contract intentionally maps lower-dimension Selection.isInheriting() to a parent-interface edit guard. If retained, clarify naming/error text; if changed, require native feature evidence first.
recommended_root_decision.t007: Remain UNVERIFIED until a documented native candidate is exercised in a fresh authorized engine run.
